subunit: Monomer, dimer, trimer, tetramer and pentamer, disulfide-linked or non-covalently associated, in homomeric and heteromeric combinations. Can also form a complex either with GHBP or with the alpha2-macroglobulin complex

complexes.name: Growth hormone receptor-ligand complex
complexes.function: Receptor-ligand complex which regulates postnatal body growth. metabolism, organ development, and sexual maturation. Activates JAK2/STAT5 signalling to stimulate production of insulin-like growth factor 1 (P05019) and increase levels of glucose and free fatty acids
complexes.properties: One GH1 molecule binds asymmetrically to the same region of the extracellular domain of two GHR1 proteins through two distinct GH1 binding sites, causing receptor dimerization.
